title: Classical syntomic producers and relative open-curve coefficients
summary: Classical rigid and log-syntomic assembly, precise integral period comparisons, semistable and rational adapters, filtered Frobenius connections, relative curve residues and Frobenius-point evaluation, on shared realization carriers.

layers.title: Filtered Frobenius connections and extension evaluation

targets.name: FilFMIC
targets.statement: Define FilFMIC(S,σ) with objects (H_dR,H_rig,c,∇,F,Φ): coherent B_K- and B†_K-modules, c:H_dR⊗B_K B†_K≃H_rig, an integrable algebraic connection on H_dR, a finite exhaustive separated descending integer filtration with finite locally free graded pieces satisfying ∇F^j⊆Ω¹⊗F^(j−1), and a horizontal B†_K-linear isomorphism Φ:σ*H_rig≃H_rig. The induced connection on H_rig uses continuous differentials. Morphisms are pairs of linear maps preserving c, connection, filtration and Φ.
hypotheses: p is prime; V is a complete mixed-characteristic (0,p) DVR with perfect residue field k; K=Frac(V), K0=Frac(W(k))
in addition V has an endomorphism F_V inducing x↦x^p modulo pV; S=Spec(B) is smooth affine over V; σ:B†→B† extends F_V and induces x↦x^p modulo pB†

locator.where: Definition 2.1 and Remark 2.2, pp. 3–4; AM line 117, AM line 131, AM line 155

api.name: FilFMIC.ofData
api.statement: The displayed geometric data and verified axioms construct an object.

api.name: FilFMIC.hom_ext
api.statement: Two morphisms with equal de Rham and rigid component maps are equal.

api.name: FilFMIC.fiberProductEquivalence
api.statement: Identify this category with filtered connections fibred over connections against overconvergent Frobenius connections.

api.name: FilFMIC.forget
api.statement: Give additive realization functors and their coefficient-extension comparison; the de Rham realization is faithful, since c determines the rigid component. The rigid realization need not be faithful on generic-only components.

tests.name: FilFMIC_zero
tests.statement: Both modules zero, the unique connection and finite zero filtration give the zero object; Φ:0≃0 is invertible.

tests.name: FilFMIC_unit
tests.statement: Rank one with c natural, ∇=d, F⁰=B_K, F¹=0, Φ=σ is an object; its constant horizontal section 1 is fixed.

tests.name: FilFMIC_nonhorizontal
tests.statement: Over V[t,t⁻¹] with σ(t)=t^p, trivial ∇ and Φ(e)=t e fail horizontality since ∇Φ(e)=dt⊗e≠0. Invertibility alone must not admit this datum.

tests.name: FilFMIC_ramifiedBaseObstruction
tests.statement: For V=Z_p[π] with π²=p, a ring endomorphism fixing p sends π to valuation 1, while π^p has valuation at least 2. Their difference cannot lie in pV=(π²). Thus the required p-Frobenius modulo p does not exist, including at p=2. This base is admitted in the classical layers, not as an AM base.

tests.name: FilFMIC_genericOnlyRealization
tests.statement: For S=Spec(K) as a smooth affine V-scheme, B†=0. The datum H_dR=K,H_rig=0 with the unit filtration is admitted, and its identity is nonzero on de Rham realization but zero on rigid realization. Only the de Rham realization is asserted faithful.

targets.name: FilFMIC.tensorTatePullback
targets.statement: On FilFMIC define direct sums, tensor with the convolution filtration and tensor connection, the tensor unit, and duals with their dual filtration and inverse-transpose Frobenius. For every integer m define O_S(m) by Φ=p^(−m)σ and F^(−m)=B_K, F^(−m+1)=0. A morphism g:S′→S of smooth affine V-schemes induces a tensor pullback. Change of compatible Frobenius lift σ→σ′ gives tensor equivalences satisfying identity and cocycle laws; no equation gσ′=σg is required when pullback is defined through isocrystals.

in addition V has an endomorphism F_V inducing x↦x^p modulo pV; S=Spec(B) is smooth affine over V; σ:B†→B† extends F_V and induces x↦x^p modulo pB†
S′ is smooth affine and carries a compatible Frobenius lift

api.name: FilFMIC.tateTensor

api.name: FilFMIC.pullback_comp
api.statement: Pullbacks compose up to the canonical tensor natural isomorphism; identity pullback is identity.

api.name: FilFMIC.changeFrobenius_cocycle
api.statement: The equivalences for σ,σ′,σ″ compose canonically and preserve the de Rham component.

api.name: FilFMIC.dualEvaluation
api.statement: The evaluation and coevaluation are horizontal, filtered and Frobenius compatible and satisfy the triangle identities.

tests.name: FilFMIC.tensorTatePullback_twistOne
tests.statement: O(1) has F⁰=0, F⁻¹=B_K and Φ=p⁻¹σ; the opposite exponent is rejected.

tests.name: FilFMIC.tensorTatePullback_tensorCancel
tests.statement: O(1)⊗O(−1)≃O(0), and a zero factor gives zero.

tests.name: FilFMIC.tensorTatePullback_identityPullback

targets.name: FilFMIC.exactStructure
targets.statement: Equip FilFMIC with the Quillen exact structure whose conflations 0→H′→H→H″→0 are exact on F^j of the de Rham realization for every j∈ℤ. Compare with strict exactness and the induced rigid exact sequence. Tensor, duality and the pullbacks and equivalences of 1.2 preserve conflations. On the supplied general Yoneda construction export Ext^i(H,H′) for i≥0, Baer addition, Q_p-linearity, splicing, pushout, pullback and coefficient-category naturality.

Use an essentially small model, with Ext transported back independently of the model

api.name: FilFMIC.conflation_iff
api.statement: A short sequence is a conflation exactly when each F^j sequence is exact.

api.name: FilFMIC.ext_map
api.statement: Conflation-exact functors induce maps on all Yoneda groups, commuting with splicing and Baer addition.

api.name: FilFMIC.ext_zero
api.statement: Ext⁰ is Hom and split 1-extensions represent zero.

api.name: FilFMIC.ext_universe
api.statement: Changing the small model induces canonical group isomorphisms preserving representatives.

api.name: FilFMIC.ext_cup
api.statement: The biexact tensor product gives Ext^i(O,H)×Ext^j(O,H′)→Ext^(i+j)(O,H⊗H′) for i,j≥0, compatible with associativity, the unit and the Koszul symmetry.

tests.name: FilFMIC.exactStructure_splitExtension
tests.statement: 0→H→H⊕O→O→0 is exact on each filtration step and has Yoneda class zero.

tests.name: FilFMIC.exactStructure_zeroCoefficient
tests.statement: Ext¹(O,0)=0 and Ext⁰(O,O) is the actual filtered horizontal Frobenius-compatible endomorphism group.

tests.name: FilFMIC.exactStructure_nonStrictIdentity
tests.statement: At Spec(Z_p), take A with F⁰A=K and B with F⁰B=0, F⁻¹B=K, both Φ=σ. The identity B→A is a morphism but not an isomorphism or a strict admissible map; its inverse does not preserve F⁰. Underlying-module exactness must not define conflations.

targets.name: FilFMIC.syntomicConnectionComplex
targets.statement: For H∈FilFMIC set A_H^j=Ω^j_(B_K/K)⊗F^(−j)H_dR and B_H^j=Ω^j_(B†_K/K)⊗H_rig for j≥0, zero otherwise. Their differential sends ω⊗h to dω⊗h+(−1)^jω∧∇h. Define S_σ(H)=Fib(1−Φ:A_H→B_H), where Φ includes σ on forms and c identifies the coefficients. This is a functor to complexes of Q_p-vector spaces, exact on conflations.

in addition V has an endomorphism F_V inducing x↦x^p modulo pV; S=Spec(B) is smooth affine over V; σ:B†→B† extends F_V and induces x↦x^p modulo pB†
Ω on B† uses the supplied continuous differential module

api.name: FilFMIC.syntomicConnectionComplex_d
api.statement: Fib(f)^j=A^j⊕B^(j−1) and d(a,b)=(da,f(a)−db), with an explicit isomorphism to the supplied cone[-1].

api.name: FilFMIC.syntomicConnectionComplex_d_sq
api.statement: The differential squares to zero by integrability, horizontality and transversality.

api.name: FilFMIC.syntomicConnectionComplex_map
api.statement: Morphisms act componentwise and yield a fibre triangle natural in H.

api.name: FilFMIC.syntomicConnectionComplex_exact
api.statement: A conflation gives a degreewise short exact sequence of coefficient fibre complexes.

api.name: FilFMIC.syntomicConnectionComplex_cup
api.statement: Construct the natural homotopy-coherent pairing S(H)⊗S(H′)→S(H⊗H′) from the two multiplicative maps 1 and Φ, giving the unit and graded symmetry on cohomology.

tests.name: FilFMIC.syntomicConnectionComplex_pointUnit
tests.statement: At k=F_p, S(O(0)) is [Q_p —0→ Q_p] in degrees 0,1; both cohomology groups are Q_p. The degree-zero class 1 is the cup unit.

tests.name: FilFMIC.syntomicConnectionComplex_pointTate
tests.statement: At the same point S(O(1)) is Q_p in degree 1, since F⁰O(1)=0. It is not the fibre of 1−p⁻¹ on all of K.

tests.name: FilFMIC.syntomicConnectionComplex_zero
tests.statement: S(0)=0. The two-term fibre of multiplication 2 on Q is [Q —2→ Q] and is acyclic, including the sign on its second differential.

targets.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation
targets.statement: For every i≥0 and H∈FilFMIC construct the Q_p-linear map u_i:Ext^i(O_S,H)→H^i(S_σ(H)). For an admissible i-extension, apply S_σ and send 1∈H⁰(S_σ(O_S)) to its iterated connecting image. At i=0 it sends f:O_S→H to the class f(1). Prove independence of the extension representative, additivity, pushout/pullback naturality and compatibility with the de Rham projection to H^i(A_H).
hypotheses: p is prime; V is a complete mixed-characteristic (0,p) DVR with perfect residue field k; K=Frac(V), K0=Frac(W(k))
in addition V has an endomorphism F_V inducing x↦x^p modulo pV; S=Spec(B) is smooth affine over V; σ:B†→B† extends F_V and induces x↦x^p modulo pB†

api.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_representative
api.statement: u_i sends a representative to δ(1), with connecting maps in extension order.

api.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_natural
api.statement: Base pullback, coefficient morphisms and change-of-σ realization commute with u_i.

api.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_deRham
api.statement: Projection to A_H agrees with evaluation after forgetting Φ.

api.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_cup
api.statement: For i,j≥0, u_(i+j)(E cup E′)=u_i(E) cup u_j(E′), using ext_cup and syntomicConnectionComplex_cup with their actual coefficient tensor.

tests.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_degreeZero
tests.statement: For i=0, the identity of O maps to 1; the zero map maps to zero.

tests.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_split
tests.statement: Every split 1-extension evaluates to zero.

tests.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_pointNonSplit
tests.statement: Over Spec(Z_p), extension with basis h,e, F⁰M=M, ∇=0, Φh=h, Φe=e−h gives u_1=(0,h) in coker(1−Φ on H)=Q_p. This is nonzero; it detects reversal of 1−Φ.

targets.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_injective
targets.statement: If F⁰H_dR=0, u_1 is injective. For every conflation 0→H→M→O_S→0 there is a unique e∈F⁰M_dR mapping to 1. Under c its class is (∇e,(1−Φ)e); it satisfies d∇e=0 and (1−Φ)∇e=d((1−Φ)e). Thus define δ(E)=∇e and R_σ(E)=(1−Φ)e without a quotient ambiguity. δ is unchanged by Frobenius-lift transport. Under the identified underlying extension and filtered lift e, R_σ′−R_σ=(Φ_σ−Φ_σ′)e, where Φ_σ′ is the transported Frobenius from the supplied isocrystal equivalence. No σ-independence of R is asserted.

F⁰H_dR=0

api.name: FilFMIC.extension_filteredLift
api.statement: Strict exactness identifies F⁰M_dR with B_K, so the lift is unique.

api.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_injective
api.statement: A zero representative yields a horizontal Φ-fixed filtered splitting; a splitting yields zero.

api.name: FilFMIC.delta
api.statement: The first component lies in Ω¹⊗F⁻¹H_dR and equals the de Rham evaluation.

api.name: FilFMIC.frobeniusRemainder
api.statement: The second component lies in H_rig and satisfies dR_σ=(1−Φ)δ.

tests.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_injective_splitLift
tests.statement: In H⊕O the lift e=(0,1) gives δ=0 and R_σ=0.

tests.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_injective_pointTateRemainder
tests.statement: For H=O(1) at Spec(Z_p), Φe=e+a h gives (∇e,(1−Φ)e)=(0,−a h). The sign must be negative.

tests.name: FilFMIC.extEvaluation_injective_noFzero
tests.statement: For H=O(0) at the same point, lifts of 1 in a split extension differ by c h. Therefore unique-lift coordinate projections are not exported without F⁰H=0.

layers.title: Rigid syntomic assembly on natural coefficient fields

targets.name: RigidSyntomic.specializationDiagram
targets.statement: For smooth separated finite-type X/V construct, on the imported realization carriers, the natural map sp_X:RΓ_dR(X_K/K)→RΓ_rig(X_k/K), its composites sp_r from F^rRΓ_dR, and its compatibility with pullback, finite field extension and products. Retain the scalar-extension map bc:A=RΓ_rig(X_k/K0)→C=RΓ_rig(X_k/K) and σ-semilinear φ on A. Choices of algebraic compactification, rigid frame and resolution yield coherently equivalent diagrams, not additional intrinsic structure on X.
hypotheses: p is prime; V is a complete mixed-characteristic (0,p) DVR with perfect residue field k; K=Frac(V), K0=Frac(W(k))

locator.where: §5 and §4.22, manuscript pp. 16–18; BesserI line 625, BesserI line 648, BesserI line 663

api.name: RigidSyntomic.specialization_natural
api.statement: For f:Y→X, f*_rig sp_X=sp_Y f*_dR, with the coherent comparison on resolutions.

api.statement: sp_(r+1) factors through the filtration map F^(r+1)→F^r.

tests.name: RigidSyntomic.specializationDiagram_empty

tests.name: RigidSyntomic.specializationDiagram_notEquivalence

targets.name: RigidSyntomic.complex
targets.statement: Define RΓ_rsyn(X,r)=Fib(f_r:A⊕F^rRΓ_dR(X_K/K)→A⊕C) in enhanced Q_p-complexes, where f_r(a,b)=((1−p^(−r)φ)a,bc(a)−sp_r(b)). Define H^q_rsyn(X,r)=H^q of this fibre for q∈ℤ. This is contravariant in smooth separated finite-type X/V and independent of all presentations. The Frobenius part is Q_p-linear; it is not generally K0-linear.

api.name: RigidSyntomic.complex_independent

api.name: RigidSyntomic.cohomology

tests.name: RigidSyntomic.complex_pointWeightZero
tests.statement: For V=Z_p and r=0, f(a,b)=(0,a−b). Thus H⁰=Q_p on the diagonal, H¹=Q_p on the first target component, and all other groups vanish.

tests.name: RigidSyntomic.complex_genericOnly
tests.statement: If X_k is empty, the fibre is F^rRΓ_dR(X_K), rather than zero.

targets.name: RigidSyntomic.basicTheory
targets.statement: The fibre triangle of 2.2 gives, for every q∈ℤ, the long exact sequence with middle map H^q(A⊕F^rRΓ_dR)→H^q(A⊕C) induced by f_r. Finite Zariski Čech covers give descent. Construct associative unital graded-commutative products H^i_rsyn(X,r)×H^j_rsyn(X,s)→H^(i+j)_rsyn(X,r+s), compatible with both realization maps and pullback. If K=K0, identify RΓ_rsyn(X,r) with Fib((1−p^(−r)φ)sp_r:F^rRΓ_dR→RΓ_rig(X_k/K)), without assuming sp is invertible.

api.name: RigidSyntomic.cech
api.statement: The pullback to a finite Čech nerve is an equivalence.

tests.name: RigidSyntomic.basicTheory_elimination

tests.name: RigidSyntomic.basicTheory_gMfrobenius
tests.statement: For t on G_m and σ(t)=t^p, φ(dlog t)=p dlog t; in weight 1, (1−φ/p)dlog t=0. A twist p instead of p⁻¹ fails.

tests.name: RigidSyntomic.basicTheory_emptyProduct
tests.statement: Cohomology of the empty scheme is zero and every product involving it vanishes.

targets.name: LogSyntomic.divisiblePD
targets.statement: For a log-syntomic X/W(k), n≥1 and r≥0 define J_n^⟨r⟩ using a level n+s, s≥r, by the Frobenius-divisibility submodule of J_(n+s)^[r] on which φ lands in p^r O_cr,n+s, followed by the standard reduction modulo p^n. Construct φ_r:J_n^⟨r⟩→O_cr,n by division at that higher level. Prove auxiliary-level independence, Z/p^n-flatness, reduction J_(n+1)^⟨r⟩⊗Z/p^n≃J_n^⟨r⟩, and equality with J_n^[r] for 0≤r≤p−1. For j≤0 use J^[j]=O_cr and the source’s compatible degree conventions in PD de Rham presentations.
hypotheses: p is prime; V is a complete mixed-characteristic (0,p) DVR with perfect residue field k; K=Frac(V), K0=Frac(W(k))
X is log-syntomic over W(k)

api.name: LogSyntomic.divisiblePD_independent
api.statement: The maps from larger s identify the reduced divisibility modules and φ_r.

api.name: LogSyntomic.divisiblePD_reduce
api.statement: Reduction in n commutes with divided Frobenius.

api.name: LogSyntomic.divisiblePD_smallWeight
api.statement: For r≤p−1 the inclusion into J_n^[r] is an equality.

api.name: LogSyntomic.dividedFrobenius_spec
api.statement: On a divisible lift x, p^r times its divided image is φ(x), with independence proved using the higher level, not inferred from this equation modulo p^n alone.

tests.name: LogSyntomic.divisiblePD_weightZero
tests.statement: At r=0, J_n^⟨0⟩=O_cr,n and φ_0=φ.

tests.name: LogSyntomic.divisiblePD_smallPrime
tests.statement: At p=2,r=1, the small-weight equality J^⟨1⟩=J^[1] applies even though the exact period theorem of 4.3 has range r≤0.

tests.name: LogSyntomic.divisiblePD_noDivisionModp
tests.statement: In Z/p, multiplication by p kills both 0 and 1. Thus the equation p y=0 does not define a unique divided image; a definition using arbitrary division modulo p is rejected.

targets.name: LogSyntomic.complexes
targets.statement: Define S_n(r)=Fib(1−φ_r:J_n^⟨r⟩→O_cr,n) and S′_n(r)=Fib(p^r−φ:J_n^[r]→O_cr,n) on the log-syntomic site. On the étale site use their derived pushforward Rε_* and name the comparison explicitly. For every q∈ℤ give the corresponding crystalline long exact sequences, with J^⟨r⟩ for the divided version and J^[r] for the undivided version. On the syntomic site identify the divided fibre with the kernel sheaf using surjectivity; that identification is not silently transported to the étale site.

targets.name: LogSyntomic.omegaTauProducts
targets.statement: Construct ω_r:S′_n(r)→S_n(r) from (p^r,id) on source and target coefficients and τ_r:S_n(r)→S′_n(r) from (inclusion,p^r). Retain the source’s warning that τ has no general multiplicativity contract; no algebra-map instance for τ is exported.

targets.name: Syntomic.modifiedTateLattices
targets.statement: For r≥0 let L(r)=Z_p(r), a=floor(r/(p−1)), b=r−(p−1)a, so 0≤b<p−1. Define L_EN(r)=(p^a a!)⁻¹L(r), and for a specified CN decomposition r=(p−1)a_c+b_c with a_c≥0 and 0≤b_c≤p−1 define L_CN(r;a_c)=p^(−a_c)L(r). These are lattices inside Q_p(r), and their mod-p^n versions are L/p^nL, not subgroups obtained by dividing elements in Z/p^n. Construct inclusions and scalar-coordinate isomorphisms. For a_c=a, L_EN=(a!)⁻¹L_CN and the inclusion L_CN→L_EN has cokernel killed by p^v_p(a!). If the alternative CN endpoint decomposition exists, its lattice differs by one factor p; transport period maps and error bounds explicitly.

gaps.detail: GrothendieckEulerForms Layer 0 supplies ExactStructure and conflation-exact functors. Its Layer 5 supplies Ext for abelian categories, not the missing general Yoneda theory. Required extension: for an essentially small R-linear Quillen exact category, Ext^0=Hom and Ext^i is the quotient of admissible i-extensions by zigzags, with Baer addition, R-linearity, splicing, pullback/pushout and exact-functor naturality; canonical agreement with Mathlib Abelian.Ext in the canonical abelian case. No enough-injectives or abelian hypothesis on Fil-F-MIC is assumed. For a biexact tensor product require external extension products and the induced unit-source cup products, with their associativity and symmetry comparisons.
